Required (name WxH): b_iso_mill 80x88, b_iso_bakery 64x62, b_iso_mine 64x60, b_iso_smelter 64x66, b_iso_smith 80x72, b_iso_tower 64x88, b_iso_market 80x70, b_iso_monument 112x120; plus for each a _scaffold version (same size: wooden poles, partial walls, ladder). Use helper functions (isoBox, isoRoof) defined once at the top of the file to avoid repeating code.
